intro: StorageCafe has no industry-statistics page for Green Bay, and the listings table is not split by climate control. The all-unit-types 10x10 average is $111/month (September 2026). StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe listings all-unit-types averages; no climate split and no industry-statistics page); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe listings all-unit-types average $70 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. Listings-page all-unit-types average $111 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). The table is not split into non-climate and climate-controlled rates. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city. Non-climate listings from about $100 (Oct 2026).
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe listings all-unit-types average $118 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe listings all-unit-types average $126 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Non-climate listings from about $125 (Oct 2026).

local_tips: Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
